title: regime_label backfill iterates weekdays not actual trading calendar - holiday rows skipped silently
description: scripts/regime_label_daily.py backfill loop iterates Mon-Fri weekdays. Chinese A-share trading calendar excludes Spring Festival cluster, October golden week, scattered single-day holidays. Current backfill runs on those days, finds no source CSI300 row, logs 'data missing' warning, and skips silently. Acceptable for cron-disabled state but would create false 'missing data' alerts in production. Codex REV-7 P2.3 (drawer 51d51693). Recommend: switch to actual trading calendar lookup (e.g. tushare cal_date or aistock-side trading_calendar table) before prod cron enable.
required_verification: test_backfill_skips_chinese_holidays_2026 (new) - asserts no INSERT on Spring Festival + golden week
Codex re-review of trading calendar integration
closure_requirements: Trading calendar source identified (tushare or aistock internal)
Backfill skips holidays without warning noise
Documented in regime_label cron operations procedure
